verdicts.corrected_value: No rotation period is established. In the project's own Sector 32 SPOC 2-min PDCSAP light curve (transits masked, 30-min bins), the strongest Lomb-Scargle peak (0.5-20 d) is at 7.97 d with semi-amplitude ~550 ppm (~1.1 mmag peak-to-peak; ~3 cycles in 25.8 d), matching the catalogue values (Gao+2025 8.18 d, Schmitt+2026 8.11 d, Wang+2025 7.98 d, TESS-SVC 7.98 +- 0.79 d). The same period is absent in Sector 6 TESS-SPOC PDCSAP (<~0.1-0.2 mmag; top peak 12.5 d, 170 ppm), and SAP/QLP light curves are dominated by systematics. Ground surveys (KELT/ASAS-3/ASAS-SN) are null but insensitive below ~1.8 mmag. The ~8 d signal is single-sector and unconfirmed (stellar rotation or PDC residual).
verdicts.reason: The reconciler's statement that the ~8 d signal is 'not recovered in the project photometry' is false: it is the dominant periodicity of S32 PDCSAP. The audit s15 check used SAP only, which is dominated by sector-length trends. The conclusion 'no rotation period' still holds because the signal is absent in S6 PDCSAP and covers only ~3 cycles.
